name: Muddy Baptism
desc: Win your first battle at the Border Fords.
flavor: Thornwick's crows already know your company's scent.

name: Carver of Tallies
desc: Slay 100 enemies across your campaign.
flavor: A modest heap by Border Fords standards.

name: Reaper of Thornvael
desc: Slay 1,000 enemies across your campaign.
flavor: Grave-diggers in four provinces owe you overtime.

name: Tusk-Breaker
desc: Defeat the Ironhide beast in the Greywood ravine.
flavor: Enough salted bacon to feed Thornwick till thaw.

name: Snuffed Cauldron
desc: Slay the renegade hexer of Redmarsh Hollow.
flavor: Even the bog-frogs sound relieved.

name: Rust and Silence
desc: Destroy the Elder Juggernaut on the Iron Coast.
flavor: Three centuries of fury reduced to scrap iron.

name: No Haven for Traitors
desc: Intercept Commander Malrik before he reaches Ember lines.
flavor: He stole the keys; you kept the lock.

name: Ashes of the Court
desc: Complete Act IV and shatter the Ember Reckoning.
flavor: Nobody left to tax the cinders.

name: Everyone Walks Back
desc: Complete any mission without losing a single squad member.
flavor: An administrative miracle the quartermaster will frame.

name: Unbroken Company
desc: Complete ten missions with zero mercenary fatalities.
flavor: Either brilliant tactics or cowardly running. Both work.

name: Something Sharp and Old
desc: Equip your first Tier 5 relic item.
flavor: Try not to ask whose finger it came off.

name: Walking Treasury
desc: Equip Tier 5 gear in every slot on your hero.
flavor: Bandits weep just calculating your ransom.

name: Star-Crowned Magister
desc: Equip Astral Archon Wand, Archmage Diadem, and Star Robe.
flavor: Oakhaven's elders would kill for that wardrobe.

name: Walking Bastion
desc: Equip Gothic Full Plate, Aegis of the Citadel, and Dread Crest Helm.
flavor: Arrows bounce off; bridges groan underneath.

name: Briar-Born
desc: Wield both Thorn Blade and Thorn Staff in the same squad.
flavor: The roots whisper to each other when you camp.

name: Heavy Purse
desc: Accumulate 10,000 gold coins in your company chest.
flavor: Heavy enough to drown a careless ferryman.

name: Merchant Prince of Mud
desc: Accumulate 50,000 gold coins at one time.
flavor: You could buy Thornwick twice and still hate the smell.

name: Seasoned Sellsword
desc: Reach level 10 with your hero.
flavor: You survived long enough to learn everyone's names.

name: Scourge of the Four Acts
desc: Reach level 20 with your hero.
flavor: Even veterans step aside when you enter the tavern.

name: Legend in Scarred Iron
desc: Reach maximum level with your hero.
flavor: Songs will lie about how clean your boots were.

name: Inked Fingers
desc: Learn 10 different spells from scrolls or tomes.
flavor: Your sleeves smell permanently of ozone and tallow.

name: Keeper of Forbidden Pages
desc: Learn every Tier 5 spell tome in the realm.
flavor: Three synods have already drafted your arrest warrant.

name: Spare the Deserter
desc: Show mercy to the cornered picket captain in Border Fords.
flavor: Kindness is expensive; hope he remembers the debt.

name: Ash Over Ink
desc: Destroy the tax ledgers during the Ashbrook Retreat.
flavor: Half of Thornwick suddenly forgets how to read.

name: Full Bellies in Redmarsh
desc: Save all grain stores during the Redmarsh Granary Raid.
flavor: The garrison eats bread instead of boiled belts tonight.

name: Shepherd of the Mire
desc: Escort the Fleeing Column without losing a single cart.
flavor: Mud, tears, and stubbornness got them through.

name: Faster Than the Swell
desc: Complete Hourglass Rescue with time to spare before high tide.
flavor: Dry boots on the Iron Coast—a rare miracle.

name: Bucket Brigade
desc: Save at least half the piers during Burning Harbor.
flavor: Oakhaven's shipwrights owe you a pint and a plank.

name: The Unburnt Key
desc: Choose the vault path at Threshold Choice without slaying the wardens.
flavor: Even headless statues seemed surprised.

name: Altar of Cinders
desc: Choose the sacrificial path at Threshold Choice.
flavor: Some doors only open when fed smoke.

name: Border Cartographer
desc: Complete every mission node in Act I: Border Fords.
flavor: You know every ditch between Thornwick and Ravenwatch.

name: Fen-Walker
desc: Complete every mission node in Act II: Redmarsh.
flavor: Leeches recognize you as kin.

name: Breaker of Tides
desc: Complete every mission node in Act III: Iron Coast.
flavor: Salt water couldn't rust your resolve.

name: Conqueror of Ash
desc: Complete every mission node in Act IV: Crown and Ember.
flavor: Not a single ember left unturned.

name: Danger Close
desc: Knock out one of your own mercenaries with your own fireball.
flavor: Apologize after the battle—if they wake up.

name: By a Thread of Mail
desc: Finish a mission with your hero under 5% health.
flavor: Your surgeon aged ten years watching that.

name: Dry Canteen
desc: Complete five consecutive missions without drinking a single potion.
flavor: Alchemists hate you; your liver thanks you.

name: Toll for the Drowned
desc: Strike the cracked bronze bell inside the Sunken Sanctum.
flavor: Something beneath the water rang back.

name: Statues Don't Blink
desc: Stand motionless for two full minutes on a battlefield.
flavor: Even the crows wondered if you'd turned to stone.

name: Scrap Peddler
desc: Sell 100 pieces of equipment to town merchants.
flavor: One man's rusty sword is another man's pension.

name: Full Roster
desc: Fill every mercenary slot in your company.
flavor: More mouths to feed, more shields to hide behind.

name: Armchair Marshal
desc: Issue 50 commands while the game is paused.
flavor: Time stands still so you don't have to bleed.

name: Dominoes of Bone
desc: Kill 5 enemies with a single Corpse Burst cast.
flavor: Messy, efficient, and deeply impolite.

name: Not Done Yet
desc: Use Tome of Resurrect to revive a fallen veteran mid-battle.
flavor: Get back up; your contract isn't finished.

name: Forgot the Scabbard
desc: Win a skirmish with no weapon equipped in your hero's main hand.
flavor: Thornwick tavern rules apply everywhere.

name: Citizen of Everywhere
desc: Visit Thornwick, Redmarsh, Oakhaven, and Ironcamp.
flavor: Four towns, four distinct flavors of mud.

name: Iron Discipline
desc: Complete the campaign on Hard difficulty.
flavor: You earned every scar the slow way.

name: Crown of Cinders
desc: Complete the campaign on Nightmare difficulty.
flavor: Thornvael tried its worst and ran out of graves.

name: Penniless Victor
desc: Win a mission with zero gold left in your purse.
flavor: Nothing left to lose makes men reckless.

name: Beneath the Seals
desc: Uncover the hidden chamber in Undervault Links.
flavor: Some doors were lead-sealed for good reason.
